name: University of La Verne
description:
The University of La Verne is a private university, around 35 miles from Los Angeles. At eight regional campuses in California, La Verne provides undergraduate and postgraduate courses and professional degrees.

Today, the university has over 50 undergraduate courses and more than 20 postgraduate qualifications. It also offers further education opportunities through doctorates and credential programs. With over 6,000 students at all levels, including hundreds of international students, La Verne provides an inclusive and diverse learning environment.

What is the University of La Verne acceptance rate for International Students?

The University of La Verne acceptance rate is 76%.

The University of La Verneâ€™s main campus provides students with many modern facilities to support learning and extracurricular activities. On campus, the arts are well supported, with several galleries, photography studios and theatres. The university also has four sports venues for athletics, fitness and swimming.

As well as the La Verne campus, the university has nine additional locations around southern California. Among these are a College of Law in Ontario, the Vandenberg Space Force Base and a Naval Base in Ventura County.

Student Life

A vibrant on-campus community exists at La Verne, and the university has its own culture and traditions. Also, students can join clubs and sports teams or take up other hobbies. Some of the extracurricular options include performing arts, radio presenting, leadership roles and athletics clubs.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Students who attend La Verne will have different options for accommodation. At present, there are three different halls of residence at the university. First, Citrus Hall is available for first-year students. and it has a range of two and three-bedroom options. Alternatively, students can find housing at the Vista La Verne or the Oaks.

However, the university works with some rental property owners to provide off-campus accommodation. Students can find a list of rental accommodations off campus on La Verneâ€™s official website.
